tells.1: Stock 'part of our community' thanks and an overly even, compressed cadence.
tells.3: Template opener plus a bullet list that repeats facts just stated, then extra softening ('No pressure at all').
tells.5: The soft 'quietly working on something' opener is a familiar launch-email template.
tells.6: Impersonal shift to 'existing customers' / 'their' and a flat, over-trimmed close.

reason: Version 5 reads most like a skilled writer: a truer subject line, a concrete image, and natural cadence, so that is the one I would send. Version 4 is close but plainer; 1 and 6 are thinner, 2 is an unpolished draft, and 3 is the most template-like.
